title: Reduce complete alternating-plane replay time by 25.24% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

The complete PR5624 primary replay repeats both halves of each symmetric adjacency power. This implementation computes one triangle and mirrors it, retaining the entire scientific consumer.

```text
P = A^k, A symmetric
for i <= j: compute (A P)[i,j] once
assign both symmetric entries
```

Claim type: scoped implementation-equivalence proof with exact finite conformance and local performance evidence. Five alternating fresh-process pairs show **25.24% less median complete-command wall time**, from 0.477749666 s to 0.357171625 s. Every pair improves, the timing ranges are disjoint and no command fails. The change avoids 5,628,000 repeated integer summands across five power updates. No new decoder theorem, κ or selected-frontier change is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Ali Romman / #5624 retains credit for the complete primary verifier, graph, certificate and decoder proof. The new package retains the full-plane/native lineage and notices for Chris R / Clear1nsight, Chafik Boukhalfa, Rohan Arun, icekylinx, CubeJerry, Mark / Matarener, Ryanson Jonathan, Philippe Van Velzen, Cinna Davis and Adam Gall. Matrix-power symmetry is classical; no global algorithm-priority claim is made.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19372133). Source #5624: `087e121aa8b98d4fb4c16e68f137578a8131d2e2`. Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The delivered scope matches the claim and stops at the first verified implementation improvement.

## Evidence

- Every one of the 564,480 reached power entries agrees with the original integer recurrence. The entire final result agrees with both the original complete consumer and its byte-identical saved result.
- All scientific checks remain, including 651 principal minors, native maps, tariffs and four original rejection controls. The exact source adapter rejects unrelated consumer edits.
- All 1,099 simple labeled graphs on one through five vertices pass five power steps, covering 133,525 entry comparisons. Ten new rejection controls and two signed/zero commuting controls pass.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64: warning-strict normal and optimized verifiers pass, taking 1.221 s and 1.148 s. The registered two-command runner passes in 2.474 s. Direct primary, metadata/source pins, committed bytes/source history, AST syntax/function checks and official export integrity pass. Both direct checks also pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH and unchanged files/modes. Ruff is unavailable.
- `BENCHMARK.json` is generated by `benchmark.py` and bound to the source/result hashes. Baseline range is 0.463201875 to 0.488030500 s; candidate range is 0.355174584 to 0.378462125 s. The profile identifies repeated power sums as the dominant path. Timing includes complete CLI work and process startup; it is local evidence, not a CI performance threshold. Other activity was not controlled, and a correctness process overlapped the start of the final series.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/symmetric-spectral-replay/replay.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/symmetric-spectral-replay/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/symmetric-spectral-replay/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/symmetric-spectral-replay
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/symmetric-spectral-replay --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 path can replace the local interpreter. For new local timing, run `benchmark.py` with the same interpreter and `-I -W error -B`. No third-party dependency is required. Direct verification prints generated SHA256-bound receipts and writes no package files.

## Limitations

The helper is justified for the reached powers of one symmetric adjacency matrix. Symmetric arbitrary factors need not commute; explicit counterexamples guard against that generalization. The package isolates a source-bound substitution and leaves frozen predecessor bytes unchanged. Its retained scientific checks are coverage preservation, not an audit deliverable or a new claim to the predecessor mathematics.

No universal runtime ratio, physical supplier, native caller, compiler/outer admission, finite-precision, stock, tape or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. Lean, Docker, selected cold replay, independent human review and formal proof-kernel review are unrun or unclaimed. The current selected-baseline metadata/source orientation passed. Managed-runtime, inherited function-length and fixed-module instrumentation deviations are documented in the README.

## Open next questions

Should this substitution be adopted in the primary verifier? First review the exact adapter and run the registered equivalence checks on the intended platform. Maintainer acceptance and platform-specific timing remain the blockers. No larger optimization search is proposed.

## Related open work

Live open-PR and cached full-pagination searches found no other open PR on this exact replay or its 336-port spectral quantity. The closeout refresh inspected this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM; none of the other submissions studies that replay or quantity, and no same-quantity numerical disagreement was found. The merged #5950 studies a different rank-135 fitting matrix on the same ports; it is credited context, not a predecessor step or a target here. The merged #5624 is the retained primary source. Search coverage does not establish absence of unpublished work or arbitrary code-diff overlap.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at head `c24e3a753c727da6d65ebe643b2531967435f87c` in [run 41624787926](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41624787926): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41624787926/job/125879302302) in 4m33s and [replay (research/symmetric-spectral-replay)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41624787926/job/125881451164) in 1m28s. The checks were read once; the run metadata independently confirms completed status, success and the matching head.

Hosted replay certifies the registered warning-strict normal and optimized correctness commands. All local checks above also passed. CI does not certify the local performance ratio, independent human acceptance or formal proof-kernel review. No CI failure remains.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Nine files under `research/symmetric-spectral-replay/`. Shared code, frozen packages and the selected result are unchanged. Archive retention would not itself admit a supplier.
